conclusion: No demonstrated training-strength improvement for unrestricted chance or CPW at S1024 in this finite one-start/one-training-seed probe. CPW100 DEV relative+6pp failed independent100-pair confirmation:49.75% vs control50%, paired delta-.25pp CI[-10,+9.75]. Formal teacher unchanged; long-run and multi-training-seed effects not established.

confirmation_selection.reason: Primary100-step DEV panel CPW51% vs matched old-data45%; preliminary relative benefit6pp, no absolute gain over initial-native52%. Test whether this relative difference survives independent game seeds;500 is diagnostic, not used to select primary.

execution_only_amendments.reason: Greedy evaluation uses the existing default serial path (omit execution). Explicit backend=serial was rejected before any games; policy, seeds, budget and all completed collection/training unchanged. Generator corrected accordingly.

report_only_amendments.reason: Serial greedy evaluation exports no execution_stats. Omit that optional batch-counter field in analysis; collection, training, evaluation configurations and behavior unchanged.
Unrestricted chance exports common chance counters only. Restrict widening-specific summary counters to CPW; no collection/training/evaluation behavior change.

scope: One frozen16500-step teacher, one200-game collection per algorithm, fixed labels and finite split training; no self-iteration or causal isolation of label noise from trajectories.
